how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-deadmines-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:166:obj:0: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
rows.quest:166:details:0: There is but one task left for you to complete. Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated. While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of ⟦E1⟧ that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all. Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
rows.quest:166:completion:0: ⟦1⟧, your bravery is remarkable. The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of ⟦E1⟧. With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood. Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.
rows.quest:167:obj:0: Bring ⟦E2⟧ Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:167:details:0: We were deep in a vast mine in ⟦E1⟧, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.
rows.quest:167:details:1: BYou look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful. He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
rows.quest:167:completion:0: My suspicions were correct. My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
rows.quest:168:obj:0: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:168:details:0: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in. If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them. If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
rows.quest:168:completion:0: Thank you for collecting these, ⟦3⟧. Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy. I will see to it that the families are notified.
rows.quest:214:obj:0: Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
rows.quest:214:details:0: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas. But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.
rows.quest:214:details:1: BThat being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can. The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout. When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you. Good luck, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:214:completion:0: Well done, ⟦5⟧! On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts. Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
rows.quest:2040:obj:0: Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2040:details:0: Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:2040:details:1: BDeep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
rows.quest:2040:completion:0: Well done, ⟦7⟧. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
